answer: A farm faces $29 per docket, and 300 dockets before the first reward is released for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. Every entry must show Estuarybound harbour agent pier seal before the ledger opens, because a seal agents renew after harbour hearings. The clerk notes pearl. The tally keeps meadow. sparrow stays on the record.
